label: Pen Script (handwriting write-on)
description: Cursive handwriting that writes itself on, as if by pen -- a real connected-script font revealed stroke-by-stroke with an ink-roughened edge. The signature opening beat of print/paper films (a line writes at macro zoom, then the camera pulls back). Short lines only (1-6 words); pair with typewriter or plain type for the rest of the sentence.

write_seconds.label: How long the writing takes (default scales with length, max 3)

mask_path.label: Hand-traced pen path (SVG d) overriding the auto sweep -- for hero macro shots where exact pen order matters. Trace against ?debug grid at font-size 200, baseline y=236.

mask_stroke_width.label: Mask stroke width in viewBox units (with mask_path; default 84)
